parameters.query:
SELECT
    n.news_id,
    r.run_id,
    n.country,
    n.source,
    n.original_title,
    n.summary_text,
    n.original_url,
    n.published_at,
    n.text_basis
FROM runs AS r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
    COALESCE(
        r.generation_settings->'selected_news_ids',
        '[]'::jsonb
    )
) AS selection(news_id)
JOIN news_overview AS n
    ON n.news_id = selection.news_id::bigint
WHERE r.run_id = $1
  AND n.processing_status = 'success'
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(n.summary_text), '') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY n.country, n.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, n.news_id;
